observations: Large multifunctional printer with a touchscreen control panel.
Brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model 'bizhub PRO C754e' are printed on the front panel in photo 0.
The machine has a black lower section and a white upper section with multiple paper trays.
The top glass surface is covered with plastic wrap.
The unit is located in an outdoor or semi-outdoor environment with other office equipment visible in the background.

claims.claim: large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer
Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have a faulty print head.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and printing a test page.

risks.risk: The internal drum and toner may be old or used.
risks.proof: A photo of the drum and toner showing the current date stamp.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap on the glass may conceal scratches or damage.
risks.proof: A photo of the glass surface without the plastic wrap.

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the drum and toner showing the current date stamp.
Photo of the glass surface without the plastic wrap.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photos, allowing for a valuation at the worst-case scenario.
